text:
maddie: Quick design check — I'm working on a compact validation checklist pattern for the Create API Key form. Leaning toward inline field errors + a lightweight top summary for keyboard users. Thoughts? :thinking: ryan: +1 for inline for immediacy. Main concern is long forms where errors get scrolled out of view — summary helps users find everything at once. jeff: If we show a top summary it should be actionable (links to fields). Also important: focus management — move focus to first error on submit. :thumbsup: sophia: Agree with jeff. A11y nit: explicit "Required" text reads better with screen readers than just an asterisk. It also avoids relying on color. maddie: Example copy option: "Organization name — Required" vs "Organization name *". I kinda prefer the explicit word for clarity, but it does add visual weight. ryan: Explicit text is clearer but noisy. Maybe show the word "Required" only on initial load for fields without any value, then hide after the user starts typing? Not sure. jeff: Please avoid color-only indicators. If we need a compact marker, combine an a11y-visible label + low-contrast asterisk for visual users. Also: contrast checks for error red. sophia: For destructive actions (delete API key) we discussed typed confirm vs simple modal. For bulk deletes, typed-confirm adds friction for power users. Proposal: 2-step pattern — modal with strong warning + "I understand" checkbox + undo toast (30s). Reserve typed confirm for org-level destructive ops. maddie: That matches my instincts. Per-key deletes get modal + undo, org-level nukes get typed confirm. We should document when to escalate to typed confirm. ryan: Implementation detail: after validation fail, set focus to the summary region with role="alert" and aria-atomic="true" so screen readers announce the change. Also add anchors in the summary list to each field. jeff: Quick snippet for the summary region: ```html
3 errors. Go to key name
``` sophia: Tiny copy tweak for undo: prefer "You can restore this key for 30 seconds" over "Undo available for 30s" — clearer and more helpful. maddie: I'll mock two variants: (A) inline-only with focus-linked summary that appears on submit, and (B) inline + persistent "Required" label. I'll post comps by EOD. @ryan please add PM constraints and expected error categories. ryan: Will do. Also add analytics event: `validation.summary_clicked` and `validation.focus_moved` so we can measure if people use the summary links. design-bot: Created follow-up task D-432 to track comps & a11y review. :white_check_mark: maddie: Thanks everyone — will circulate before EOD.
